CALLER STATED THAT A CONTAINER TANK CONTAINING UN2734, HAZ CLASS 8, FELL OVER ON ITS SIDE ALONG WITH THE TRUCK THAT IT WAS ON. IT WAS APPROXIMATELY 200 YARDS FROM THE SAVANNAH RIVER. THE TANK DISCHARGED APPROXIMATELY 25 GALLONS FROM THE OVERFLOW VALVE ONTO THE ASPHALT. THERE WAS MINOR SMOKING BUT NO FIRE. SORBENT WAS THROWN ONTO THE LEAKED SUBSTANCE. GEORGIA PORT AUTHORITY CALLED IN CRANE TO RIGHT THE TANK. THERE WAS NO BREACH TO THE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY OF THE TANK.
